# Name: # Sailing mooring points: where a player boards or leaves their own boat. See SailingMoorings.
# Name, Sailing level and quests: OSRS Wiki 'Mooring point' (Docking points table, rev 15355932);
# Land: the walkable tile the gangplank or mooring point is used from, and Berth: the boat's tile
# when moored, both from the GPS plugin's cache-derived sailing-moorings.tsv
# (runelite-gps-plugin@961c3ba81241), matched to the wiki row whose map pin is within 8 tiles of the
# berth. Last Light, missing from that table, has its requirements from the wiki's 'List of islands'
# (rev 15333567). Quests marked 'Partial completion' on the wiki are listed under
# Quests started. Vessels: the boats that fit, empty for every boat.
# Not modelled: 'must have visited Kourend/Varlamore', Entrana's prohibited items. Missing: Wyrmscraig
# Cavern (level 62, Fallen From Grace started, raft or skiff only), which has no cache-derived land tile.
# Land is moved off the GPS plugin's blocked tile at Wintumber Island (where the player lands, checked in game)
# and Tear of the Soul (the walkable tile east of it).
# Dock: the game's dock id (DB table sailing_dock, column dock_id, cache 2746), which a boat's port varbit holds.
# Shipwright: yes where a shipwright recovers boats (OSRS Wiki 'Shipwright' locations); island moorings can't.
